Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly reinterpreted “performer” as Mark Bell (a producer/collaborator) using a flawed heuristic, instead of Björk, who is the actual performer of "Hunter (Björk song)". This led to giving Mark Bell’s birthplace (Leeds, England) despite WebSurfer’s results correctly indicating Björk’s birthplace as Reykjavík, Iceland.
